sources.title: Urban Greening Factor guidance
sources.verified_claim: The adopted UGF guidance explains how major developments apply London Plan Policy G5 and calculate urban greening, with borough-specific evidence and targets where available.

sources.title: Air Quality Positive guidance
sources.verified_claim: Air Quality Positive guidance requires large-scale development and masterplanning to demonstrate design measures that maximise local air-quality benefits and reduce exposure; applicability depends on proposal scale and facts.

sources.title: MD3050 London Plan Guidance: Air Quality Neutral, Air Quality Positive and Urban Greening Factor
sources.verified_claim: MD3050 records formal adoption of UGF, Air Quality Neutral and Air Quality Positive guidance as detailed implementation guidance to the London Plan, while noting guidance does not create or change London Plan policy.

sources.title: London Green Infrastructure Framework dataset
sources.verified_claim: The LGIF dataset provides London-wide green-infrastructure analysis and downloadable spatial data, including corrected April 2026 results; it supports evidence and prioritisation but does not itself establish parcel planning status.

sources.title: Waste and recycling
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's waste programme sets regional objectives for waste reduction, reuse, recycling and lower-carbon treatment; regional goals are context rather than parcel waste-capacity proof.

sources.title: ADD2831 Waste model update
sources.verified_claim: City Hall approved a 2026 update to the waste model used to support planning evidence, funded from the Waste and Circular Economy budget; model updating does not determine an individual parcel outcome.

sources.title: London Plan evidence base documents
sources.verified_claim: The official datastore hosts the July 2026 London Plan Viability Study phase 1 report and annexes, providing current plan-wide viability evidence rather than site-specific viability.

sources.title: London Plan evidence - MBUL
sources.verified_claim: The official MBUL evidence dataset includes utilities impact assessment, optimisation methodology, sustainable access measures, tall-building evidence and strategic transport modelling for the Draft London Plan; these are regional evidence inputs, not sample-parcel determinations.
